question: In a certain code language, ‘OXFORD’ is written as ‘OODFRX’ and ‘KILLING’ is written as ‘IIGKLLN’. How will ‘SOLUTION’ be written as in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9641975f2fc7524ff111ee5de92ae0deecda54903f9932e1bcb1ebbbc99a46.png] 

**Logic:** First Vowels and then Consonants are placed according to their position value.

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da84f585cb2999c2532ac20f7f12819d0e104e5a3cc99e8fe0be98f94ab875f9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57c942d84d028f9e4211eddf32a17b402a16893262165a584c8e78df76dbc4da.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/321544d2bb9a9b6e25dee684d2ec0ef6041915bc7b2fac3067f9c728fd72435c.png] 

Hence, '**IOOULNST**' is the correct answer.
